propositions: A ticket with a live supersedes or duplicates link cannot be closed with --class=superseded or --class=duplicate without --force, because close_plan_review_gate_check does not receive the close disposition and cannot exempt administrative closes based on link evidence.

The plan-review close gate refuses superseded tickets unconditionally despite the completion gate exempting them on the same evidence, creating an asymmetry where the only non-force exit is a bypass that degrades the audit trail.

close_plan_review_gate_check signature lacks close_class and disposition parameters, making it unable to check for link-backed administrative dispositions even though the callers in transition_close.py have this information available.

The gate omission was introduced when administrative dispositions were extended to task/story/epic in commit fc20-2df1-426e-42ab, which updated close_precheck.py and transition_close.py but did not update gates.py, leaving the plan-review gate blind to the new evidence standard.
